title: Bone Circle
style: Progressive phonk with a slow hypnotic 136 BPM drive and shamanic drum pulse; verse stays sparse with twin-vocal call-and-response, pre-chorus strips to percussion and breathy tones, chorus opens into layered chants and pitched drone harmonies. Whispered ad-libs, wide delay throws, reverse swells into transitions, crisp low-end and earthy ceremonial mix, male vocals., hypnotic, trance, low, rhythmic, deep, breathy, drone, didgeridoo, slow
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I step in slow
Dust on my boots

Twin tones call me
Twin tones answer you

Hands on the hide
Beat like a warning

I keep it low
But I keep it coming

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold that breath
Let it bend

Right on the edge
Here it comes again

[Chorus]
Run the bone circle
Run it back again

Run the bone circle
Till the night gives in

Run the bone circle
Hear the old one sing

Run the bone circle
We come back again

[Verse 2]
Salt on my tongue
Smoke in my hair

I hear your voice
Hidden in the air

Slow drum talk
Moon on the sand

You pull me under
I take your hand

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold that breath
Let it bend

Right on the edge
Here it comes again

[Chorus]
Run the bone circle
Run it back again

Run the bone circle
Till the night gives in

Run the bone circle
Hear the old one sing

Run the bone circle
We come back again

[Bridge]
Hush now
Feel the ground move

One more step
And the dark gets loose

[Chorus]
Run the bone circle
Run it back again

Run the bone circle
Till the night gives in

Run the bone circle
Hear the old one sing

Run the bone circle
We come back again
